background.value: plain white recommended; no patterns, shadows, or gradients

head_height.value: 3.2-3.6cm (32-36mm) from crown to chin; top of head to photo edge 2-6mm

clothing_restriction.value: no turtlenecks or clothing obscuring facial features

expression_restriction.value: neutral expression, mouth closed, no teeth showing, both eyes fully open (updated March 3, 2025)

glasses_policy.value: not prohibited but removal recommended for reliable identification; if worn, no colored/tinted lenses, no glare/reflection, frames must not cover eyes

ears_visibility.value: ears should ideally be visible; hairline and ears visible when possible

face_visibility.value: full face clearly visible; hair must not cover eyes or face contour; clear contrast between face/hair and background

headwear_policy.value: no hats, hair bands, or head coverings; religious/medical exceptions permitted if face contour visible

accessories.value: no colored contacts or pupil-enlarging lenses; no veils obscuring facial features
